description: PII redaction in logs, monitoring, and telemetry pipelines. Must: identify all PII fields in application logs (emails, phone numbers, SSNs, IP addresses), deploy a log redaction sidecar (FluentBit with Lua filter), configure Elasticsearch ingest pipelines for redaction, verify redaction is working on sampled logs, and tune false-positive rate. Risk factors: redaction regex too aggressive mangling non-PII data, redaction missing new PII fields, performance overhead of regex matching on high-volume logs. Tools available: FluentBit, Elasticsearch, Lua, Kibana, kubectl.
